notes.title: Improvements
notes.content:
Hello, bandits!

We've just uploaded a small patch with minor improvements:

- coursor in Drinking Game now flashes when hover it over a bottle
- quest related information hides after a while so it doesn't obstruct the view
- small stability improvements
- fixed some bugs during fist fights

We are currently working on performance and other fixes that we've noticed. Next updates coming next week.

Remember that this our first 3D game released on Steam and we are eager to hear from you about your experience with the game. Let us know through Discord.

Cheers!

PS. Here's some gameplay from the pre release version :D

[previewyoutube=_-GAxWd1ct8;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: New name, new trailer, demo update
notes.content:
Hello, fellow Bandits,

As we are getting closer to releasing the game, we have a few announcements!

First of all, we are changing the name of the game. Bandit Brawler better reflects the game genre and vibe. Since we will be punching a lot of suckers in the face, it only made sense.

Bandit Simulator is dead. Long live[b] Bandit Brawler[/b].

Secondly, there is a large update coming for the demo tomorrow. The list of [b]fixes[/b] includes:
- graphical fixes
- bleeding mechanic fix
- adjustments to UI
- bugs hunted
- changes in some NPC behavior
- better chest contents
- urinating on folks works better now
- adjustments to the quests UI

Also, we are very proud to introduce to you our [b]launch trailer[/b] which you can watch on the game's Steam profile.

Enjoy! The game's coming very soon!

Titanite Games

notes.title: Bandit Simulator demo is back online
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

As of few hours the game's demo is back online. We've did some serious bug hunting and managed to polish a couple of the game's aspects:

- game's UI
- bug fixes within quests progression
- enemy AI 
- additional languages
- game balance

We've also added two features that are for you to discover ;-)

More news soon to come.

Have fun!

notes.title: Bandit Simulator - demo udpate
notes.content:
Fellow Bandits,

After here feedback from some of you we've delivered a couple of imporvements and tweaks to the demo including:

- new Papi the Chicken model
- improved opening animation
- improved control icons for gamepad
- improved navigation on trading screens when you use a gamepad
- hiding mouse coursor when playing with a gamepad
- gold visible on the main UI
- numerous small fixes

Thank you all for your feedback. It helps us a lot on working on Bandit Simulator.

If you have any additional ideas or remarks contact us on Discord: https://discord.gg/gbsXxc2q

See ya all!

notes.title: New Crazy Demo Available NOW!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35566116/54fbb2e585a70c796f4d396b2c3fc87e2045c263.png[/img]

We know you have waited for a long time! Too long! But the wait is over and your sinister adventure is almost here! Today we share a free demo - and a completely new one (the old one got old, right? ;)). 

With this Demo we introduce to you some new features and concepts that we added to the game:

[list]
[*] New, crazier story
[*] Beautifully improved art
[*] New UI
[*] Throwing objects in brawl fights
[*] New destructibles
[*] More citizens NPC
[*] New attack sounds
[*] Kick is knocking the enemy back
[*] Slap is stunning enemies
[*] Heavy punch is knocking enemies down
[*] New attack animations
[/list]

notes.title: Bandit Simulator - Devlog #2
notes.content:
[h2][b]Hello, bandits![/b][/h2]

[h3]Today we want to tell you about the locks, houses and taverns you will be able to visit in our game. [/h3]

                                    [u]                                                                                                [/u]

There will be many types of buildings and chests in the game with different contents. Of course, to "visit" the house while the owner is away, you will have to deal with locks, which will become more and more difficult to open after each “visit”. 


The same goes for opening chests. In order to get the loot, you will have to face a lock.


          [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35566116/a1dd367d267e2ba13edefb6a0110f853016a7616.gif[/img]


And when it comes to taverns, it will be fun. Not only that you can talk to the innkeeper there, you can bet a penny in tavern games, and even get into a fight. 


          [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35566116/68f6e93ac93de2164f4625b2481214ac51052bbc.png[/img]


[b]What do you think, what are the strangest items you can find deeply hidden in a medieval mansion?[/b]
And remember, hit add to wishlist button, to be up to date.

                                    [u]                                                                                                [/u]

Best regards
Bandit Simulator team
